title: specgen: add autoupdate label warning to response
body:
Do not log the warning inline as it will only be seen on the server, add it to the warnings list which is actually send via the API to the client which then also logs it directly.

Fixes: 866e28fc6a70 ("libpod: do not inherit auto update labels from image")
